name: Asa
source:
Asa, a humble peasant from The First Village on Nieshima, the Isle of Offerings, played a pivotal role in sparking a rebellion against the oppressive officials. He welcomed an Outlander into his home, who presented a cursed "Box" as a means to challenge their oppressors. 
With the help of this mysterious artifact, Asa and his fellow islanders successfully overthrew their tyrannical rulers. 

[spoiler]After their victory, the islanders began adopting family names to mark the beginning of a new era. Asa chose the name Ichikura, signifying his origins from The First Village. Thus, he became the first Ichikura and the guardian of the Kotori-bako, the very Box that had been instrumental in their liberation.[/spoiler]
